title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah hoists the Tricolour at his residence in New Delhi as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah hoists the Tricolour at his residence in New Delhi as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign

‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign, launched under the leadership of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji, further strengthens the sentiment of patriotism and pride in the heart of every Indian
Tiranga stands for the sacred pride we take in our nation and the might of our unity
Crores of countrymen are connecting with the Tricolour and empowering the spirit of ‘Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat’
The Home Minister appealed to every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement
Every citizen should celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at their homes and uploading a selfie on
http://harghartiranga.com

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
13 AUG 2026 5:40PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah hoisted the Tricolour at his residence in New Delhi today as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ campaign. The Home Minister appealed to every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement and celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at their homes and uploading a selfie on
http://harghartiranga.com
.

In a post on X, Union Home Minister said, “Today, at my residence in New Delhi, I hoisted the Tricolour under the
#HarGharTiranga
 campaign. This campaign, launched under the leadership of Modi ji, is today further strengthening the sentiment of patriotism and pride in the heart of every Indian. Today, crores of countrymen are connecting with the Tricolour and empowering the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat.”

आज नई दिल्ली स्थित अपने आवास पर
#HarGharTiranga
 अभियान के तहत तिरंगा फहराया।
मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में शुरू हुआ यह अभियान आज हर भारतीय के मन में राष्ट्रप्रेम और गौरव की भावना को और मजबूत कर रहा है। आज करोड़ों देशवासी तिरंगे के साथ जुड़कर एक भारत, श्रेष्ठ भारत की भावना को सशक्त कर…
pic.twitter.com/GDseHiVs8K
— Amit Shah (@AmitShah)
August 13, 2026

The Home Minister said in another post on X, “The Tiranga stands for the sacred pride we take in our nation and the might of our unity. Joined the
#HarGharTiranga
 movement by hoisting our national flag. I urge every citizen to unite with millions of others in this movement and celebrate patriotism by hoisting the Tiranga at your homes and uploading a selfie on
http://harghartiranga.com
.”

The Tiranga stands for the sacred pride we take in our nation and the might of our unity.

August 13, 2026
